caption: This black-and-white drawing features a collection of architectural and decorative design elements, all outlined with thin black lines against a beige background. Objects include various ornamental motifs such as fan-shaped and shell-like forms, scrollwork, and finials. There are also profiles of moldings, a pair of vertical turned balusters, and a curved bracket. Some objects resemble hinges or escutcheons, and there is a circular rosette with radiating lines at the upper left. In the lower right are a fluted pilaster capital and a small object labeled with the numbers "31 5." The drawing is organized within a rectangular border, and the individual elements are spaced evenly, without overlapping. All objects are rendered in line art, with minimal shading except for a single dark shadow beneath one fan-shaped motif at the top center.
title: Grandfather's Clock
